Built on a vertically integrated national digital infrastructure, du Tech’s platform provides sovereign AI inference, GPU as a Service, and Model as a Service to government entities, large enterprises and SMEs

Press Release

DUBAI, United Arab Emirates: du, the leading telecom and digital services provider, through its operating sub-brand du Tech, today announced the launch of ‘National HyperAI’, a sovereign AI inference and agentic platform designed for UAE government entities, large enterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) . The platform enables organizations to move beyond AI testing and pilot projects to deploy AI solutions and autonomous agent at scale, in line with the UAE’s national AI strategy and ambitions. 

National HyperAI brings together sovereign AI inference, GPU as a Service (GPUaaS), Model as a Service (MaaS), and autonomous agent workflows under a single commercial agreement. By combining these capabilities, the platform helps organizations overcome challenges related to AI deployment, infrastructure complexity and operational cost, while simplifying procurement and implementation for regulated institutions.

Built directly on du Tech’s National Hypercloud, a sovereign hyperscale cloud platform certified by the UAE Cyber Security Council. National HyperAI extends the company’s existing sovereign cloud capabilities to support advanced AI applications.

Through this integration, organizations can connect existing mission critical workloads, sovereign databases, and enterprise applications to high performance AI inference without transferring sensitive data to external environments. This unified architecture reduces integration complexity while extending existing compliance, governance, and national security controls into the AI layer.

Unlike solutions that depends on leased infrastructure and multiple technology providers, du owns and operates the underlying digital stack across five live data centers in the UAE. The integrated architecture encompasses liquid cooled hyperscale data centers, national fiber and 5.5G connectivity, bare metal NVIDIA GPU compute, MLOps orchestration, curated open weight models, and agentic orchestration delivered alongside technology ecosystem partners.

By operating entirely within the UAE, National HyperAI ensures that customer data, model weights, and compute capacity remain within national borders, supporting data residency requirements under a single accountable operator.

National HyperAi is designed to meet the regulatory, security, and operational requirements of government ministries, national security authorities, large enterprises and SMEs. The platform offers three core services: Sovereign AI Inference, Model as a Service (MaaS), and GPU as a Service (GPUaaS).

Jasim Al Awadi, Chief ICT Officer of du, said: “The UAE’s leadership has set a clear vision to lead the global shift toward an agentic, AI-driven economy. While organizations across the public and private sectors have proven what AI can do in isolated pilots, scaling into production requires sovereign assurance, predictable economics, and unified accountability. With du Tech’s National Hyper AI, du brings together something no other provider in the nation can offer: complete ownership of the data centers, national connectivity, sovereign inference compute, and an end-to-end delivery journey under one roof. We are proud to stand as a trusted partner supporting the UAE’s AI ambitions by enabling government entities and enterprises turn AI opportunities into practical and measurable outcomes.” 

National HyperAI is available immediately to government entities and enterprise organizations across the UAE.

About du

du adds life to life with a comprehensive portfolio of mobile, fixed, broadband, entertainment services, and fintech solutions. Through a digital-first approach powered by ultra-reliable fiber and 5G technology, du delivers bespoke solutions leveraging cloud computing, AI-driven analytics, advanced cybersecurity, and IoT integration. As a trusted digital telco enabler spearheading the UAE's digital transformation, we collaborate with a dynamic partner ecosystem to propel industries and society toward operational excellence, shaping a more connected and digitally advanced future across the region.
